attributes.action: Stop MP’s from standing in a by-election after their resignation
attributes.background: If an MP resigns, they should not be allowed to participate in the by-election caused by their resignation, as they have stepped down from the role. There should be a period of time between resignation and being allowed to stand as a candidate again.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Prevent MPs who resign their seat from standing for re-election for 12 months" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776390
